title: ReLU Lab
tagline: A course playground for decision regions, hidden ReLU features, and one-dimensional function approximation.
summary: Compare four-point and filled-region XOR, train simple ReLU networks on standard or custom two-dimensional datasets, inspect hidden units and the three-dimensional score surface, then switch to one-dimensional targets to contrast constructive piecewise-linear approximation with optimization from random weights.
highlights: Switch between four XOR points, filled XOR, standard datasets, and points placed directly on the plot.
Compare a linear model with one- and two-hidden-layer ReLU networks while inspecting every hidden feature.
View the learned score as a three-dimensional surface and locate the z = 0 decision boundary.
Construct fixed-knot approximations to continuous one-dimensional targets or train the same width from random weights.
Use short lecture prompts to separate evidence, representational capacity, and optimization.
